# St Aldric MRD Cohort

The 212-patient post-resection pancreatic cancer cohort from St Aldric University Hospital that underpins the [[pancreatic-cfdna-mrd-study|Pancreatic cfDNA MRD Study]]. This note is a pointer to the governed dataset and a summary of what it contains; no patient-level data live in the vault.

## Summary

> [!abstract]
> 212 patients with resected pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, operated at St Aldric between 2022-03 and 2024-06, with plasma before surgery, at post-operative day 28 and every three months for up to 24 months, plus baseline buffy coat and resected tumour tissue. 1,468 plasma time points; 121 recurrences at the 2025-12-31 data freeze.

## Key Details

- **Patients**: 212; median age 67 (range 41–84); 54% male. Stage I 31, stage II 128, stage III 53. 171 received adjuvant chemotherapy.
- **Samples**: 1,468 plasma time points (median 7 per patient), 10 ml Streck tubes processed within 72 hours at St Aldric, stored at -80 °C. 1,402 passed extraction QC ([[cfdna-extraction-qc-log-2025]]). Baseline buffy coat for all 212; matched buffy coat sequenced for 60 so far ([[ch-buffy-coat-pilot-results-2026-01]]).
- **Tumour tissue**: resected tumour sequenced (exome) for 212; usable tumour-informed variants for 189. The 23 failures were mostly low cellularity.
- **Imaging**: CT every three months for two years, then six-monthly. Recurrence is radiological or biopsy-proven, adjudicated by [[samuel-okoye|Samuel Okoye]] and a second surgeon blind to cfDNA results.
- **Outcomes**: 121 recurrences and 74 deaths at the 2025-12-31 freeze; median follow-up 23 months. Recurrence and death are cross-checked against the Northern Cancer Registry under the [[registry-linkage-agreement|institute linkage agreement]] ([[registry-recurrence-extract-2026-03]]).
- **Clinical variables**: listed in [[st-aldric-data-dictionary-v3]], current export [[st-aldric-clinical-export-2026-01]].

## Governance

- Ethics: St Aldric research ethics approval with the 2025 amendment that added Corvane as analysis site and allowed registry linkage ([[st-aldric-ethics-amendment-2025-05]]).
- Consent covers cfDNA, tumour and germline research, and data sharing with "academic collaborators under a data transfer agreement". Whether that covers transfer of derived data to the Halo consortium, or Halo data into this analysis, is being handled through the [[data-access-policy-revision|Data Access Policy Revision]].
- Data steward: [[yara-castellanos|Yara Castellanos]]. Access via the governed project space only; analysis runs on Halyard in the project's restricted partition.
- `access: guarded-write`: the release folder is read-only for analysts. New releases are written by the data steward only.

## Why It Matters

Everything in the MRD study depends on this cohort: the classifier is trained on it, the CH filter is calibrated on it, and the manuscript's numbers come from it. Its one structural weakness is that it is a single-centre cohort with samples extracted in two kit-lot batches, which is why the reviewers ask for external validation and why batch handling became central ([[batch-confounding-in-cfdna-studies]]).

## Caveats

- Pre-operative samples were extracted mostly before the 2025-06-16 kit lot change and follow-up samples mostly after it ([[extraction-kit-lot-change-2025-06-16]]). Any analysis comparing time points must model extraction batch.
- Imaging intervals vary in practice (median 13 weeks, IQR 11–16), which matters for lead-time estimation ([[molecular-lead-time]]).
- 20 patients withdrew from follow-up sampling before 12 months; they are kept for the landmark analysis only.

## Source Location

Corvane governed research storage, root `corvane_governed`, path `projects/st-aldric-mrd/release-2026-01/`. Last checked 2026-10-14 by Yara Castellanos. Previous release `release-2025-06/` is retained read-only for reproducibility of the submitted manuscript.
